q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a steel trunk?
title: Steel trunk carbon footprint per piece
short: Weigh the steel sheet per trunk, including offcuts, and multiply by the steel supplier's per-kg figure. Add pressing, welding, painting and oven energy, then divide the unit's energy by trunks made.
audience: Steel trunk and storage box makers

ul: Cold rolled steel sheet by weight.

p: Report per trunk by size and sheet gauge.

example.title: Worked example: steel trunk unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 7,468 / 3,000 = 2.489 kg CO2 per piece
Add steel sheet and paint for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
